name: io.github.Venut-Technologies/serato-dj-mcp
title: Serato DJ library
description: Ask AI about your Serato library: harmonic search, crate audits, previewed crate building.

packageArguments.description: Optional, off by default. The literal flag --allow-writes adds stage_crate, preview_changes, apply_changes and discard_changes: new crates are staged, shown for review, and written only when confirmed while Serato is closed, after both library databases are backed up. Leave it out and no write tool exists.
Optional, off by default. The literal flag --allow-raw-sql adds run_sql: one read-only SELECT against a snapshot copy of the library, returning raw rows with full file paths.

environmentVariables.name: SERATO_LIBRARY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The Serato library folder, the one holding master.sqlite. Not needed on macOS, where the library in ~/Library/Application Support/Serato and on mounted drives is found automatically.
